settings.share.title: Share target
settings.share.tip:
• The share target is the service a finished file is uploaded to.
• storage.to carries up to 25 GiB and lets VidShrink delete the file again, so a link can be closed early.
• uguu.se carries up to 128 MiB and clears itself after 3 hours, but it hands out no delete token, so nobody can close the link early.
settings.share.can-delete: {0} hands out a delete token, so a link can be closed before its lifetime runs out. The button works once a file has been shared.
settings.share.no-delete-window: {0} hands out no delete token, so neither you nor VidShrink can close the link early. Its own deletion after {1} hours stands in for that.
settings.share.no-delete: {0} hands out no delete token, so neither you nor VidShrink can close the link early.
settings.share.nothing: There is no file to share.
settings.share.targets-missing: The share targets could not be read; {0} was not found.
settings.share.shared-until: Shared. The link stays open until {0}.
settings.share.failed: The file could not be shared
settings.share.close-failed: The share could not be closed
settings.share.upload-busy: An upload is already running; wait for it to finish or cancel it.
settings.share.nothing-to-close: There is no share to close.
settings.update.title: Updates
settings.update.auto-effect: When this is off, VidShrink does not update itself: it only tells you that a new version exists and shows the command that installs it.
settings.update.no-self-effect: VidShrink does not update itself on this system: it only tells you that a new version exists and shows the command that installs it.
